set.intro: A short, closed list of harness options for Claude Code and Codex. Every change is previewed first, needs your confirmation, makes a backup and can be undone (also previewed first). Nothing else about either agent is editable here.
set.mod.archify.help: Installs the diagram skill for Claude Code and Codex (runs offline). The Harness page uses it to draw the architecture.
set.mod.context7.help: Registers the context7 MCP server in Claude Code and Codex so the agent can look up current library documentation.
set.mod.impeccable.help: Installs the design skill for Claude Code and Codex and downloads its pinned engine with npm (needs the network once).
set.mod.rea.help: Registers the rea MCP server in Claude Code and Codex so the agent can inspect binaries and packaged apps.
set.mod.sdd.help: Skills for planned changes (Claude Code and Codex), plus, in Claude Code only, agents, /amauta-sdd-* commands and a safety hook that checks sdd agents before they start.
set.notInstalled: amauta is not installed yet. Previewing and applying here runs the installer for the first time.
set.persona.help: How the agent talks to you: gentleman is warm and mentoring, neutral is plain and direct. Applying swaps the persona section of CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md, and the output style (Claude Code only).
set.repairHelp: Re-applies the current settings: restores missing or outdated files that amauta installed. Files you edited are kept.
set.review.help: On: after each commit amauta assesses the risk of the change and may ask for a review before you go on. Off: no review reminders.
set.telemetry.help: On: hooks record which tools ran, how long they took and how big they were, into your own local database (never content, never sent anywhere). Off: those hooks are removed.
set.undoConfirm: Undo re-runs the installer with the previous values, for Claude Code and for Codex when a Codex home is found now, and makes a fresh backup. Files you changed by hand since are not overwritten wholesale. If the Codex home is gone by then, only Claude Code is undone.
set.undoneNote: If the change had downloaded an npm engine, run Reinstall / repair to bring it back.
skills.where: Skills live in ~/.claude/skills, in plugins and in each project's .claude/skills (Claude Code), and in ~/.agents/skills (Codex).

sp.intro: Repositories whose ODD tasks, sessions, memories and graph the portal shows. Paths must be absolute, existing directories (in your home directory or elsewhere, such as a data disk), not / or your home directory itself and not a system directory; they are saved in portal.json in the amauta state directory.

set.privacy.help: On: you get a warning when a prompt seems to hold a secret (Claude Code and Codex), and Claude Code asks before reading a data file (CSV, Excel, Parquet, a database) outside test and example folders (Claude Code only: Codex reads files through its shell). Off: those hooks are removed.
set.checks.help: On: syntax and secret checks run on the changed files before the agent stops (Claude Code and Codex) and after each edit (Claude Code only), and new errors are reported to the agent. Off: those hooks are removed.
sec.lead: The memory guard is always on; the privacy hook and the checks follow your settings (Settings).
sec.codexNote: In Codex the privacy hook checks prompts only (Codex reads files through its shell, so asking before a data file is read is Claude Code only), and the checks run when Codex stops, not after each edit. The memory guard, trusted projects, checkers and profiles are shared by both runtimes.
